text:
NOTE
**Still not ready: the PR template checklist and commit cleanup are still missing**

New: The author added a regression test case and posted before/after screenshots in a comment. Missing: the description still uses a custom self-review checklist instead of the one from the PR template, and the history still has fix-up commits ("Fixes #17419", "fixed linting error to pass CI") that aren't squashed into the commits they belong to.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign a reviewer yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the test and screenshots! Please replace the self-review checklist in the description with the one from the PR template, and squash the fix-up commits into well-formed commits following our [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html).
```
